title: Socorro footprints and Hynek's conversion
summary: John Blitch tells of Socorro footprints and Hynek's conversion, about 1964 at Socorro, New Mexico, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: John Blitch, a scientist who once worked for DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, and who says he was abducted by an alien himself, tells this one on Jesse Michels' podcast. He says that in 1964 at Socorro, New Mexico, where a craft was reported to have landed, footprints were left on the ground. According to Blitch, J. Allen Hynek, an astronomer who advised the Air Force on UFO reports, saw those marks and that is what turned him from doubter into believer, which, if true, makes Socorro the moment a key skeptic changed his mind.
